tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. Every screen sits on paper. Each theme is one paper/ink pair: Night shift swaps Paper's, the colour themes bring their own.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: Raised writing surface: log posts, the entry form, dropdown lists, the stats panel. Always framed by an ink rule, never told apart by shade alone.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All text, rules, frames, icons and solid fills (was --c-black). 14.0:1 on paper, 15.5:1 on sheet.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, kind labels, card details, dt labels, timestamps. 5.5:1 on paper, 5.8:1 on sheet, 7.6:1 in night shift. The lightest ink allowed for text.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Non-text only: drag handles, disabled controls, the dimmed bars of a chart. Never for words that must be read.

tokens.name: ink-ghost
tokens.usage: Chart grid lines and the image-loading placeholder fill. (Skeleton bars pulse solid ink between 0.12 and 0.3 opacity.)

tokens.name: ink-wash
tokens.usage: The area under a cumulative line chart and a keyboard-focused chart column. Nothing else.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modals and the mobile comment sheet.

tokens.name: inverse-surface
tokens.usage: The inverted block: active/hovered items, title bars, day headers, badges, pinned posts, the danger heading. Inversion is the system's one emphasis colour.

tokens.name: inverse-ink
tokens.usage: Text and rules on inverse-surface (14.0:1). Replaces the stray #fff and #e8e6e3 used on black blocks.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline, 2px solid, offset 2px. On inverse-surface use inverse-ink at offset -4px. Replaces the browser's blue ring.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Categorical chart fill 1 (category bars, the budget meter's segments, pies, swatches). Charts only: never text, frames or UI. Under Display → Charts: mono, slots fall back to the 1-bit ramp (paper, dots, hatch, dither).

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Categorical chart fill 2 (category bars, the budget meter's segments, pies, swatches). Charts only: never text, frames or UI. Under Display → Charts: mono, slots fall back to the 1-bit ramp (paper, dots, hatch, dither).

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Categorical chart fill 3 (category bars, the budget meter's segments, pies, swatches). Charts only: never text, frames or UI. Under Display → Charts: mono, slots fall back to the 1-bit ramp (paper, dots, hatch, dither).

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Categorical chart fill 4 (category bars, the budget meter's segments, pies, swatches). Charts only: never text, frames or UI. Under Display → Charts: mono, slots fall back to the 1-bit ramp (paper, dots, hatch, dither).

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Categorical chart fill 5 (category bars, the budget meter's segments, pies, swatches). Charts only: never text, frames or UI. Under Display → Charts: mono, slots fall back to the 1-bit ramp (paper, dots, hatch, dither).

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: Categorical chart fill 6 (category bars, the budget meter's segments, pies, swatches). Charts only: never text, frames or UI. Under Display → Charts: mono, slots fall back to the 1-bit ramp (paper, dots, hatch, dither).

tokens.name: chart-rest
tokens.usage: The grouped 'everything else' slot of a categorical chart. Mono: solid ink.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links inside user content (posts, comments) on paper or sheet: the theme's own ink, brighter. Paper and Night shift keep plain ink. Never frames, fills or UI.

tokens.name: accent-inverse
tokens.usage: Links inside user content on an inverted block (pinned posts, owner comments).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The wordmark on the login page and a month's grand total. One per screen. Lowercase.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Page title. Lowercase via CSS; source text keeps sentence case.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section title inside a page or summary. Lowercase.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Dashboard section and drawer-body headings. Lowercase.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Hide this log group from your navigation and lists.
styles.usage: Default text. The root scales to 0.8em below 600px, so every em-based size follows.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: 0.85em. Card details, hints, list-row secondary text, drawer hints.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: 0.8em. Post headers, group header bar, modal content, entry form header.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: 0.7em. Comment footers, dropdown options, chart ticks (11px), tooltips. Smallest size allowed.

styles.name: label-caps
styles.usage: Button and RowButton labels: Hack bold, uppercase via CSS, 0.04em tracking. Log titles inside nav buttons are user content and keep their own case.

styles.name: kind
styles.usage: 0.75em lowercase category label above a card title, in ink-muted.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Amounts and percentages. Always font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums and right-aligned in columns.

styles.name: phone-display
styles.usage: One number per screen: a month total. 28px when it shares its row (with the budget buddy).

styles.name: phone-heading
styles.sample: how hard do you want to save?
styles.usage: Wizard questions, a settings section's title.

styles.name: phone-body
styles.usage: Default phone text: rows, posts, modal bodies.

styles.name: phone-small
styles.usage: Notes under a row, explanations, section labels (bold).

styles.name: phone-caption
styles.usage: Meta lines, hints, field labels, caps button labels.

styles.name: phone-micro
styles.usage: The floor. Chart ticks, avatar names, tags. Nothing renders smaller on any screen.

spacing.note: Spacing is em-based so it scales with the root, which drops to 0.8em on phones.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, header cell gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Button padding, nav and menu gaps, row-button groups.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Form row gaps, post footer gaps, list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card grid gaps, dashboard section gaps, stats panel padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Post padding, modal body padding, the gap between posts.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Wizard progress gaps, drawer body bottom padding, sub-heading top margin.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between dashboard sections and login blocks.

tokens.name: window-pad
tokens.usage: Inner padding of a Window frame.

tokens.name: column-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between the log menu and the content column; comment column inset.

tokens.name: gap-inside
tokens.usage: Inside one item: label to field, title to its hint. Scales with UI size.

tokens.name: gap-between
tokens.usage: Between items in a group: rows, fields, buttons. Scales with UI size.

tokens.name: gap-group
tokens.usage: Between groups in a section. Fixed: does not shrink at UI size S.

tokens.name: gap-section
tokens.usage: Between sections of a page. Fixed.

radius.note: Square by default. Rounding is a deliberate exception, reserved for things that imitate a physical, hand-made object, and each exception has its own token.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: The default for every corner: buttons, windows, modals, cards, tooltips, images, meters.

tokens.name: radius-tab
tokens.usage: Top corners only of filing-folder Tabs (6px 6px 0 0). Sanctioned exception: the paper-folder metaphor.

tokens.name: radius-bubble
tokens.usage: Speech bubbles only: comments, the budget buddy's bubble, a friend's nudge. Sanctioned exception: the speech-balloon metaphor, so every rounded bubble keeps its pointer tail.

border.note: Frame weight is the hierarchy. Line style carries meaning (see the README).

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Secondary frames: posts, compact cards, row buttons, tooltips, meter tracks, dashed list separators.

tokens.name: border-rule
tokens.usage: Default container frame: windows, modals, log menu items, cards, tabs, footer and drawer rules.

tokens.name: border-heavy
tokens.usage: Danger and errors: the danger-zone rule, a destructive button, a field in error, an error toast, an over-budget meter track.

tokens.name: border-fresh
tokens.usage: Fresh news waiting for you, as a left edge: new activity since your last visit (LogCard--fresh), an alert in the drawer, the update banner, a review waiting, an incoming friend request. Nothing else.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: A disabled control as a whole.

tokens.name: opacity-dragging
tokens.usage: An item being dragged; an editor while an image uploads.

tokens.name: opacity-blink
tokens.usage: The off-frame of the terminal blink (steps(1), 1s).

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for anything tappable on a phone, at every UI size (today --tap-min is 0 at S and M). The drawn control may be smaller; its hit area is not.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside small text and row buttons.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default inline icon (.Icon), nudged down 5px to sit on the baseline.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Icon component default when rendered standalone.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Log menu width when it stands alone.

tokens.name: main-width
tokens.usage: Max width of the content column: posts, ledger, wizard.

tokens.name: modal-width
tokens.usage: Max modal width from 768px up.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Phone breakpoint: root text drops to 0.8em, grids go single-column.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablet breakpoint: the log menu becomes a horizontal strip.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Large breakpoint.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Below this the log menu and comments drop to 0.8em.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Modal backdrop, dropdown list, comment scrim (49).

tokens.name: z-selected
tokens.usage: The post being edited and its comment column, above the scrim.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tutorial tooltips.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: #modal-root and the update banner.

tokens.name: z-snackbar
tokens.usage: Snackbars, above everything.

meta.note: Colour themes (Paper, Night shift and 15 colour skins in four families: retro, pastel, aero, after dark) synced from src/tokens.scss on 2026-11-26. Phone type, the gap-* rhythm and tap-target adopted in the Nov 2026 small-screen audit; not yet in src.

shadow.note: Flat by default. The one shadow is hard-edged and offset, like a sheet of paper lifted off the page: only for things floating above the page that aren't modal.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers, toasts, the rarity tag of unique and special knick-knacks. Never on cards, buttons, sheets or modals (those use a frame and the scrim).
